ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$, $\angle B=40^\circ$, $D$ is a point on side $BC$. The triangle is folded along $AD$ such that $AC$ falls on $AB$ and point $C$ coincides with point $E$. If $\triangle BDE$ is a right-angled triangle, what is the measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $\angle BED=90^\circ$, $\angle C=\angle AED=90^\circ$.\\
When $\angle BDE=90^\circ$, $\angle C=\angle AED=\angle B+\angle BDE=130^\circ$.\\
In summary, the measure of $\angle C$ is either $90^\circ$ or $130^\circ$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{90^\circ}$ or $130^\circ$.
